purpose: Point-in-time evidence for August2025 retrospective daily reports
methodology: available_at is earliest explicitly verified public release time where known; date-only items use23:59:59Z conservatively.
A report must select only facts with available_at strictly before its cutoff.
Source data vintages are preserved; later revisions are explicitly excluded.
analytical_implication is a conditional editorial inference, not an observed outcome or claimed positioning.
Primary sources are preferred. Search or archive dates alone do not establish economic reference-period availability.

facts.headline: NBP reference rate cut to 5.00%
facts.analytical_implication: Domestic easing supports rate-sensitive demand; bank net interest income faces a separate margin headwind.

facts.headline: ECB holds deposit facility at 2.00%
facts.analytical_implication: Trade uncertainty remains relevant despite inflation near target; rate cuts are not precommitted.

facts.headline: US Q2 GDP advance estimate rebounds to 3.0% annualized
facts.vintage_note: Use 3.0% until Aug28 12:30Z. Later estimates must not overwrite this vintage.
facts.analytical_implication: Import reversal explains part of headline strength; domestic final sales give a softer underlying-demand signal.

facts.headline: Fed holds 4.25–4.50%; Bowman and Waller favor a cut
facts.analytical_implication: The policy debate is open, but a September reduction has not been promised.

facts.headline: Treasury announces $125bn quarterly refunding
facts.analytical_implication: Supply and settlement are identifiable liquidity events; this does not establish dealer positioning or realized fund flows.

facts.headline: June PCE inflation 2.6%, core 2.8%
facts.vintage_note: Original July31 release. July PCE not an official observation until Aug29.
facts.analytical_implication: Inflation remains above target while real spending growth is modest.

facts.headline: Poland July CPI flash falls to 3.1%
facts.analytical_implication: Disinflation strengthens the easing case, subject to fiscal and administered-price risks.

facts.headline: Bank of Japan holds policy rate near 0.5%
facts.source: Bank of Japan July31 Outlook index
facts.vintage_note: Use July31 Bank view only. Meeting summary of opinions was not public until Aug8; minutes not until Sep25.
facts.analytical_implication: Japan remains in a different policy phase from easing central banks; yen carry exposure remains sensitive to normalization expectations.

facts.headline: New reciprocal tariff rates announced for August7 implementation
facts.vintage_note: Country schedules have product exemptions and special regimes. Do not describe 10% China reciprocal component as total China tariff.
facts.analytical_implication: Different exposure to imported inputs and US exports creates country and sector dispersion.

facts.headline: Apple June-quarter revenue rises 10%
facts.analytical_implication: Hardware demand remains a useful contrast to a software-only AI thesis; tariff costs and shipment timing remain risks.

facts.headline: Amazon AWS revenue grows 17.5%; AWS margin falls sequentially
facts.analytical_implication: Cloud demand and AI spending do not automatically translate into near-term margin expansion.

facts.headline: July payrolls +73k; May and June revised down by 258k combined
facts.vintage_note: Initial July employment release; do not substitute September or annual benchmark revisions.
facts.analytical_implication: Labor demand looks weaker than the pre-release picture; lower yields may help duration while economically sensitive earnings face risk.

facts.headline: ISM manufacturing contracts at 48.0
facts.analytical_implication: Manufacturing activity and employment are weak even while input prices continue to rise.

facts.headline: Euro area July HICP flash 2.0%
facts.vintage_note: Services flash3.1; Aug20 final services3.2. Headline stayed2.0.
facts.analytical_implication: Headline target convergence is compatible with persistent services inflation and uneven activity.

facts.headline: CBP confirms reciprocal-tariff implementation mechanics
facts.analytical_implication: Implementation certainty reduces one source of ambiguity but the earnings impact depends on pass-through and exemptions.

facts.headline: Palantir revenue passes $1bn with 48% growth
facts.vintage_note: After-close earnings: safe for Aug5 morning report. Avoid using before Aug4 close.
facts.analytical_implication: Evidence of AI software monetization is company-specific and must be weighed against valuation sensitivity.

facts.headline: ISM services barely expands at 50.1 with elevated prices
facts.analytical_implication: A combination of soft employment and firm input prices complicates a simple disinflation-and-growth narrative.

facts.headline: BOJ July-meeting opinions become public

facts.assessment: Tariff agreement reduces uncertainty; growth likely moderates initially.

facts.vintage_note: Not known at July31 meeting decision; publication Aug8 JST.
facts.analytical_implication: Reduced trade uncertainty can keep future normalization under consideration; it does not establish a promised hike date.

facts.headline: Bank of England reduces Bank Rate to 4%
facts.vintage_note: Final vote5–4 followed a second vote; one member initially preferred50bp.
facts.analytical_implication: The narrow decision supports gradual easing, with limited assurance about the next meeting.

facts.headline: China July CPI flat year-on-year
facts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
facts.vintage_note: Page heading explicitly dates release2025-08-10 09:30 despite URL containingAug14.
facts.analytical_implication: Weak headline pricing power remains a constraint on nominal earnings growth.

facts.headline: US–China tariff truce extended for 90 days
facts.source: White House joint statement; timestamp corroborated by contemporaneous Reuters
facts.vintage_note: Reuters report at21:42:47Z establishes public availability by then; higher fentanyl and other tariffs remain separate.
facts.analytical_implication: Near-term escalation risk falls, while unresolved structural trade issues remain.

facts.headline: July CPI headline 2.7%, core 3.1%
facts.vintage_note: Initial release; do not use later seasonal-factor revisions.
facts.analytical_implication: Benign headline inflation is partly energy-driven; core inflation still limits the scope for unconditional easing.

facts.headline: RBA cuts cash target to 3.60%
facts.analytical_implication: Lower underlying inflation permits easing; trade uncertainty and weak productivity still constrain the outlook.

facts.headline: Poland Q2 GDP flash grows 3.4% year-on-year
facts.vintage_note: Flash release supplies no expenditure-component breakdown; avoid asserting consumption/investment drivers as observed facts.
facts.analytical_implication: Domestic growth resilience contrasts with weak external manufacturing conditions.

facts.headline: July PPI rises 0.9% month-on-month
facts.vintage_note: Initial release. PPI is not a one-for-one forecast of CPI or PCE.
facts.analytical_implication: Producer pricing creates an inflation risk counterweight to weakening labor data.

facts.headline: Japan Q2 GDP first preliminary +1.0% annualized
facts.vintage_note: Aug15 08:50JST first estimate. September revision must not leak intoAug reports.
facts.analytical_implication: Domestic spending resilience keeps normalization possible even with export uncertainty.

facts.headline: Euro area Q2 GDP flash +0.1% quarter-on-quarter
facts.vintage_note: UseAug14 growth vintage; laterSep5 year-on-year revision excluded.
facts.analytical_implication: Small positive growth gives limited cushion against a trade shock.

facts.headline: Poland final July inflation confirms 3.1%
facts.analytical_implication: Services inflation remains higher than headline, tempering the case for rapid rate cuts.

facts.headline: China July output +5.7%, retail sales +3.7%
facts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
facts.vintage_note: 10:00Beijing briefing verified by SCIO; do not use August activity released inSeptember.
facts.analytical_implication: Slower demand favors selective exposure rather than a broad commodity-demand recovery assumption.

facts.headline: US July retail sales rise 0.5%
facts.vintage_note: Advance report as releasedAug15. Sales are nominal, not inflation-adjusted.
facts.analytical_implication: Consumer spending remains resilient, but front-loading and price changes can overstate real demand.

facts.headline: July FOMC minutes published
facts.vintage_note: Meeting took placeJul29–30; minutes only availableAug20. Do not backfill their detail into earlier reports.
facts.analytical_implication: The minutes describe the pre-jobs-revision discussion and should not substitute for newer data.

facts.headline: Euro area final July HICP remains 2.0%
facts.vintage_note: July services component revised from flash3.1 to final3.2; August HICP was not released untilSep2.
facts.analytical_implication: Headline stability coexists with sticky services pricing.

facts.headline: Walmart raises full-year sales and EPS outlook
facts.vintage_note: 7amUS/Central event schedule corroborates12:00Z availability.
facts.analytical_implication: Value-led retail can gain share while higher operating costs complicate profit conversion.

facts.headline: US–EU framework sets 15% tariff structure and conditional auto relief

facts.auto_reduction_condition: EU formally introduces legislative proposal to reduce tariffs

facts.vintage_note: Framework and conditions, not proof that all promised purchases or legislation occurred.
facts.analytical_implication: More predictable trade rules help planning, but the tariff floor still pressures exporters and import-intensive margins.

facts.headline: Powell signals shifting risks may warrant a policy adjustment
facts.vintage_note: PCE figures in speech are Fed estimates, not the officialAug29 BEA release. A September cut is not a commitment.
facts.analytical_implication: Easing-sensitive equities and bonds gain a plausible catalyst, but the inflation constraint persists.

facts.headline: Nvidia Q2 FY26 revenue $46.7bn with no H20 sales to China
facts.vintage_note: Aug27 after cash close; eligible forAug28 morning. Do not report as FY2025Q2.
facts.analytical_implication: AI infrastructure demand remains large, while China restrictions keep geographic revenue and policy risk material.

facts.headline: US Q2 GDP second estimate revised to 3.3%
facts.vintage_note: Do not use third estimate3.8 releasedSeptember25 or later annual updates.
facts.analytical_implication: The upgrade improves the domestic-demand signal but headline growth still reflects the import reversal.

facts.headline: Official July PCE inflation 2.6%, core 2.9%
facts.vintage_note: Original release values; subsequentSeptember annual update excluded.
facts.analytical_implication: Spending remains firm while core inflation sits above target, keeping a soft-landing thesis conditional.

facts.headline: Poland August CPI flash 2.8%
facts.vintage_note: Flash2.8 only. Final2.9 publishedSeptember15 is not available inAugust.
facts.analytical_implication: Inflation within the tolerance band supports an easing case; the pace remains uncertain.
